Name: MythicPhoenix's Shining Treasure
Author: MythicFenix
Description:
This mod changes the artifact dig spots to a little glittering mound.  I haven't gotten to test it out in all seasons very well, but I think I finally got it pretty good.  If anyone has any suggestions on how to improve it feel free to let me know.

Disclaimer:  I am not using the vanilla dirt, and didn't really test it out on that.  This will probably look better if you're using one of the mods for darker dirt.  I did test it on the beach and in winter and it is far more visible than you would think.


[code][size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list][/code]
